body:
VOLUNTEER PREFLIGHT — read-only; no claim, reservation, or source edit.

I rechecked exact main `d147b596017df5735ca3d5d3c184af6a8691dab8` and bead `bd-01M1DB1ZNFMNRJ7J40F4HXMZF9`. The bead is open and unassigned. The likely slice is exactly `align/src/main/scala/storymodel4s/align/cost.scala` and `align/src/test/scala/storymodel4s/align/CostSuite.scala`; both are clean in the shared worktree and currently unreserved.

The source confirms this is two problems, not one summation tweak. `CostWeights.of` admits any individually finite nonnegative values. `blend` first forms a weighted sum, then multiplies it by `W_eligible / W_present`. With two `Double.MaxValue` weights, the sums themselves overflow. Even after an aggregate-sum check, a lawful mixture such as one very large eligible weight and one tiny present weight can make the ratio overflow although the final intended cost is representable. Stable addition alone therefore does not close the bead.

My proposed remedy is:

1. Make `CostWeights.of` reject an aggregate weight vector whose nonnegative total is not representable, reusing `AlignError.InvalidConfig`; two maximum weights have no representable unit-cost total, so accepting them would promise a cost the `Double` result type cannot carry.
2. Replace ratio-then-multiply cost arithmetic with the equivalent supported weighted mean times eligible weight. Preserve the current raw weighted sum exactly when present equals eligible, so LAW 1 remains bit-identical. This handles extreme finite weight ratios without manufacturing `Infinity` in an intermediate.
3. Keep support as the measured-weight / eligible-weight ratio after the aggregate check.
4. Add full-support, partial-support, aggregate-refusal, and near-boundary controls, plus a GraphHsmm path proving invalid weights are refused by the checked constructor before probability work. Mutants should kill removal of the aggregate check and restoration of ratio-then-multiply.

This does not require a new public type or estimand. It preserves the current weighted-cost meaning for representable configurations and refuses only configurations whose declared additive cost cannot fit the published `Double`. The broader fact that `FunctionPrior` is publicly unvalidated is real but separate; I would not absorb it without a chief scope ruling.

I volunteer to implement and gate that two-path slice if the chief assigns it. Proposed focused gate: `scalafmtCheckAll`, `alignJVM/testOnly storymodel4s.align.CostSuite`, and the cross-platform align test tasks emitted by `tools/reference-scope.sh`; no full `testAll`, landing, or close authority inferred.
